# Imperial Truck & Trailer Repair and Wash

> Imperial Truck & Trailer Repair and Wash is a premier commercial fleet maintenance, diesel engine repair, heavy-duty parts warehouse, and high-pressure truck/RV washout facility located at 2142 W Yosemite Ave, Manteca, CA 95337. The company features 10 full-length commercial drive-in bays, ASE-certified master mechanics, dealer-level ECM diagnostic tools, and 24/7 active highway emergency roadside dispatch across Northern California.

## Business & Contact Details
- **Entity Name**: Imperial Truck & Trailer Repair and Wash
- **Address**: 2142 W Yosemite Ave, Manteca, CA 95337
- **Phone**: +1 (209) 239-8111
- **Emergency Roadside Dispatch**: 24/7 Rapid Highway Service
- **Shop Hours**: Monday – Friday: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM | Saturday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM | Sunday: Closed
- **Accepted Commercial Fleet Accounts**: Comdata, EFS, Fleet One, Wex, Visa, MasterCard
- **Website**: https://imperialtruckwashrepair.com

## Core Commercial Services
- [Diesel Engine Repair & Overhauls](https://imperialtruckwashrepair.com/services/diesel-repair): Master diesel engine diagnostics, cylinder head overhauls, in-frame rebuilds, fuel injection triage, EGR/DPF aftertreatment service for Cummins, Detroit Diesel, PACCAR, and Caterpillar engines.
- [Computer Diagnostics & ECM Scanning](https://imperialtruckwashrepair.com/services/computer-diagnostics): Dealer-level electronic scanning, live sensor telemetry, ECM/TCM/ABS fault-code isolation, parameter reprogramming, and forced DPF regenerations for Freightliner, Kenworth, Peterbilt, International, and Volvo rigs.
- [Brakes & Pneumatic Air Systems](https://imperialtruckwashrepair.com/services/brakes-air-systems): Complete heavy-duty air brake rebuilds, S-cam and bushing replacements, drum machining, air compressor overhauls, air dryer exchanges, ABS diagnostics, and 90-day BIT inspections.
- [Commercial Tires & Wheel Mounting](https://imperialtruckwashrepair.com/services/tires-wheel-mounting): Steer and drive tire mounting, computerized dynamic wheel balancing, high-torque pneumatic stud tightening, rim inspections, and 24/7 on-highway flat tire blowout assistance.
- [Wheel Seals, Shocks & Hub Assemblies](https://imperialtruckwashrepair.com/services/wheel-seals-shocks): Precision oil bath wheel seals, heavy-duty gas/hydraulic shocks, hub bearings, and axle spindle rebuilds to prevent catastrophic bearing seizures.
- [Transmissions & Heavy-Duty Clutch](https://imperialtruckwashrepair.com/services/transmissions-clutch): Eaton Fuller manual and automated manual (AMT) repairs, Allison automatic service, dual-disc ceramic clutch replacements, flywheel resurfacing, and driveline universal joints.
- [King Pins, Bushings & Steering](https://imperialtruckwashrepair.com/services/king-pins-steering): Precision king pin replacements, bronze/bi-metal bushing reaming, tie rod ends, drag links, steering gearboxes, and laser axle alignments.
- [Electrical Systems & Alternators](https://imperialtruckwashrepair.com/services/electrical-alternators): High-output commercial alternators, heavy-duty gear-reduction starter motors, 12V/24V battery bank load tests, wiring harness triage, and parasitic drain troubleshooting.
- [A/C & Cabin Climate Control](https://imperialtruckwashrepair.com/services/ac-climate-control): R134a and R1234yf commercial A/C compressor replacements, condenser leak testing, freon recharges, and heater core overhauls.
- [Eco-Friendly Truck & RV Wash](https://imperialtruckwashrepair.com/services/truck-rv-wash): High-pressure hot water washouts, 53ft trailer sanitation, engine bay degreasing, and citrus aluminum polish in dedicated drive-through washout bays.
- [Heavy Duty Truck Parts Inventory](https://imperialtruckwashrepair.com/services/heavy-duty-parts): On-site warehouse stocked with genuine OEM and premium aftermarket brake chambers, drums, air bags, leveling valves, filters, sensors, and starters for immediate bay installation or counter pickup.
- [Full Truck & Trailer Maintenance](https://imperialtruckwashrepair.com/services/truck-trailer-repair): Complete bumper-to-bumper commercial tractor and trailer repairs, structural welding, roll-up doors, landing gear rebuilds, and 90-day California BIT / DOT safety inspections.

## Operational Protocol: 4-Step Service Model
1. **Diagnostic Intake & Scan**: Rapid check-in with dealer-level ECM scanning and multi-point visual inspection.
2. **Transparent Fleet Quote**: Itemized pricing with direct billing support for fleet accounts.
3. **Master Mechanic Repair**: ASE-certified mechanics install OEM-spec parts with calibrated torque tooling.
4. **Quality Check & Road Signoff**: Secondary safety review, sensor recalibration, and clearance for highway dispatch.
